description: The Sextant file-format showcase. An eight-byte signature followed by a sequence of length-prefixed, CRC-32 checked chunks (IHDR, IDAT, IEND). Exercises a magic signature, big-endian length prefixes, a repeated chunk array, derived sizes, and a CRC-32 over each chunk's type and data.

provenance.origin: Tiny truecolor PNG images generated by corpus/png/generate.py. They are genuine, viewable PNGs so the CRC-32 values are real.
provenance.notes: Not derived from any third-party image or file. Safe to redistribute. The image content is irrelevant to the structure under test.
